actions.description: Add a user to one or more groups, leaving their existing group memberships untouched.
actions.name: add-user-to-groups

email.description: User email address, in plain (non-URL-encoded) form. Example: "user@example.com"

group_uuids.description: Array of group UUIDs to add the user to. Max 200. Example: ["0bb8915e-fe63-4e37-a1ba-102e7daa375a"]

actions.description: Add one or more direct permissions to a group, without affecting existing ones.
actions.name: assign-group-permissions

groupUuid.description: Group UUID to assign permissions to. Example: "0bb8915e-fe63-4e37-a1ba-102e7daa375a"

scope.description: Scope value. For scopeType "account" this is the account UUID; for "tenant" an environment ID; for "management-zone" the format "{environmentId}:{managementZoneId}".

permissions.description: One or more permissions to assign to the group.

actions.description: Grant a policy's access to one or more groups.
actions.name: bind-policy-to-groups

policyUuid.description: The UUID of the policy to bind to groups. Example: "6e6edf99-3ef3-40f5-adc5-635401719672"

groupUuids.description: Array of group UUIDs to bind the policy to. Example: ["0bb8915e-fe63-4e37-a1ba-102e7daa375a"]

boundaries.description: Optional array of boundary UUIDs for the binding.

actions.description: Create one or more new user groups
actions.name: create-group

actions.description: Create a new platform token scoped to a specific environment, for use against Dynatrace's environment-level Platform APIs.
actions.name: create-platform-token

accountUuid.description: Dynatrace account UUID. If omitted, it will be read from the connection configuration. Example: "9610a717-798c-423b-a80f-97cfebe72f89"

environmentId.description: Environment ID the token is scoped to. If omitted, the account's first environment is used. Example: "nsf52867"

name.description: Name of the platform token. Example: "Nango Test Token"

scope.description: OAuth scopes for the token. Example: ["storage:logs:read"]

userUuid.description: User UUID to associate with the token.

actions.description: Create a new custom access policy at the account level.
actions.name: create-policy

name.description: Policy name. Example: "Nango Registry Test Policy"

statementQuery.description: Policy statement query. Must be in the form "ALLOW service:resource-type:action;". Example: "ALLOW iam:groups:read;"

actions.description: Create a new service user (API-only identity, no login/human access).
actions.name: create-service-user

name.description: Name of the service user. Example: "Nango Registry Test SU 3"

description.description: Description of the service user. Example: "Test service user for Nango registry"

accountUuid.description: Dynatrace account UUID. Falls back to connection_config.accountUuid if omitted.

actions.description: Invite/create a new user in this account by email
actions.name: create-user

email.description: Email address of the user to invite. Example: "user@example.com"

userUuid.description: UUID of the newly created user

actions.description: Delete a user group.
actions.name: delete-group

groupUuid.description: The UUID of the group to delete. Example: "a74aebb2-50ae-427f-a404-1b15c60edb61"

actions.description: Revoke/delete a platform token.
actions.name: delete-platform-token

actions.description: Delete a custom account-level policy.
actions.name: delete-policy

policyUuid.description: The UUID of the account-level policy to delete. Example: "d0759a08-face-4a88-a520-13e892becccf"

actions.description: Delete a service user.
actions.name: delete-service-user

uid.description: The unique identifier of the service user. Example: "4cd1f263-743b-449c-9465-784bf1156c02"

actions.description: Delete a user from this account.
actions.name: delete-user

email.description: Email of the user to delete. Example: "user@example.com"

actions.description: Get the directly-assigned permissions on a group
actions.name: get-group-permissions

accountUuid.description: Dynatrace account UUID. If omitted, it will be read from the connection config.

actions.description: List just the policy uuids bound to one specific group.
actions.name: get-group-policy-bindings

actions.description: List which groups a specific policy is bound to.
actions.name: get-policy-groups

accountUuid.description: Account UUID. If omitted, it will be fetched from the connection configuration.

actions.description: Get a single policy's full definition (statementQuery) by uuid, at either account or global level.
actions.name: get-policy

levelType.description: Policy level type. Either "account" or "global". Defaults to "account" if omitted.

levelId.description: Level ID. For account level, the account UUID. For global level, the literal string "global". Defaults to metadata.accountUuid (the canonical source; falls back to connection_config.accountUuid) for account level, or "global" for global level.

actions.description: Get a single service user by uid.
actions.name: get-service-user

actions.description: Get a single user's full details including their group memberships.
actions.name: get-user

actions.description: Query the account-level audit log (IAM changes: user/group/policy/permission create-update-delete events).
actions.name: list-account-audit-logs

startTime.description: Start time in ISO 8601 format. Example: "2024-01-01T00:00:00Z"

endTime.description: End time in ISO 8601 format. Example: "2024-01-02T00:00:00Z"

addFields.description: Comma-separated list of additional fields to include. Example: "eventOutcome,accountUuid"

limit.description: Maximum number of audit entries to return.

actions.description: Get the account's assigned resource limits (users, groups, permissions, platform tokens) and current usage against each.
actions.name: list-account-limits

actions.description: List custom access policies defined directly at this account level (excludes Dynatrace built-in/global policies).
actions.name: list-account-policies

actions.description: List Dynatrace Managed clusters associated with this account (empty for SaaS-only accounts).
actions.name: list-clusters

accountUuid.description: Dynatrace account UUID. If omitted, the action reads it from the connection configuration. Example: "9610a717-798c-423b-a80f-97cfebe72f89"

clusterId.description: The UUID of the cluster. Example: "12345678-1234-1234-1234-123456789abc"

actions.description: List the monitoring environments (tenants) that belong to this account.
actions.name: list-environments

actions.description: List Dynatrace's built-in, platform-wide policies (e.g. 'Admin User', 'AppEngine - Admin') available to bind at any account or environment.
actions.name: list-global-policies

actions.description: List the users belonging to a specific group.
actions.name: list-group-members

groupUuid.description: The UUID of the Dynatrace group. Example: "3ff4aa6a-df19-44a7-9f5b-4d924dc2b283"

actions.description: List user groups in this account.
actions.name: list-groups

owner.description: Group owner type. Known values: LOCAL, SCIM, SAML, DCS, ALL_USERS

actions.description: List platform (OAuth-adjacent) tokens issued in this account, used to authenticate against environment-level Dynatrace Platform APIs.
actions.name: list-platform-tokens

actions.description: List every policy-to-group binding at this account level in one call.
actions.name: list-policy-bindings

actions.description: List service (non-human, API-only) users in this account.
actions.name: list-service-users

accountUuid.description: Dynatrace account UUID. If omitted, the value is read from the connection configuration.

actions.description: List users in this Dynatrace account.
actions.name: list-users

actions.description: Remove one specific direct permission from a group.
actions.name: remove-group-permission

groupUuid.description: The UUID of the user group. Example: "0bb8915e-fe63-4e37-a1ba-102e7daa375a"

scopeType.description: The type of the permission scope.

scope.description: The scope of the permission. Example: "9610a717-798c-423b-a80f-97cfebe72f89"

permissionName.description: The name of the permission. Example: "account-viewer"

actions.description: Remove a user from one or more specific groups without affecting other memberships.
actions.name: remove-user-from-groups

email.description: User email address, in plain (non-URL-encoded) form. Example: "user@example.com"

groupUuids.description: Array of group UUIDs to remove the user from. Example: ["0bb8915e-fe63-4e37-a1ba-102e7daa375a"]

actions.description: Replace a group's entire direct-permission list in one call.
actions.name: set-group-permissions

scope.description: Scope identifier: an account UUID, environment ID, or "{environmentId}:{managementZoneId}" for a management zone.

permissions.description: Full list of direct permissions to set on the group. Replaces existing direct permissions.

actions.description: Replace a group's entire set of bound policies in one call.
actions.name: set-group-policies

groupUuid.description: The UUID of the user group. Example: "541802b0-623c-4193-8728-036ed01d4eb4"

policyUuids.description: List of policy UUIDs to bind to the group. Replaces any existing bindings.

actions.description: Replace a user's entire group membership list in one call (removes them from any group not included).
actions.name: set-user-groups

email.description: The email address of the user. Example: "user@example.com"

groupUuids.description: List of group UUIDs to assign to the user. Max 200.

actions.description: Remove one group's binding to a specific policy.
actions.name: unbind-policy-from-group

groupUuid.description: Group UUID to remove the binding from. Example: "0bb8915e-fe63-4e37-a1ba-102e7daa375a"

actions.description: Update a group's name/description.
actions.name: update-group

groupUuid.description: The UUID of the group to update. Example: "0bb8915e-fe63-4e37-a1ba-102e7daa375a"

name.description: The new name for the group.

description.description: The new description for the group.

accountUuid.description: The account UUID. If omitted, read from connection_config.

actions.description: Change a platform token's expiration date.
actions.name: update-platform-token-expiration

expirationDate.description: New expiration date as an ISO-8601 timestamp string. Example: "2027-12-31T23:59:59Z"

actions.description: Activate or deactivate a platform token without deleting it.
actions.name: update-platform-token-status

status.description: The desired status of the platform token.

actions.description: Update an existing account-level policy's name/description/statementQuery
actions.name: update-policy

statementQuery.description: Policy statement query. Example: "ALLOW iam:groups:read, iam:users:read;"

actions.description: Update a service user's name/description.
actions.name: update-service-user

name.description: New name for the service user.

description.description: New description for the service user.

syncs.description: Sync custom access policies defined at this account level (excludes Dynatrace built-in/global policies).
syncs.name: account-policies

accountUuid.description: Dynatrace account UUID. Only needed when the connection configuration has no accountUuid.

syncs.description: Sync the monitoring environments (tenants) belonging to this account.
syncs.name: environments

syncs.description: Sync user groups in this account.
syncs.name: groups

syncs.description: Sync platform token metadata (never the plaintext secret, which is only ever returned once at creation) issued in this account.
syncs.name: platform-tokens

accountUuid.description: Dynatrace account UUID. Only needed when the connection configuration has no accountUuid.

syncs.description: Sync service (API-only) users in this account.
syncs.name: service-users

syncs.description: Sync users in this Dynatrace account.
syncs.name: users
